items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Didn’t he punch out Jimmy Knepper at one time? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, he hit him too.

ctx.x: the United States of America. All you got to do is sign this, because he’s already hit somebody here in the union office. He hit a representative.” Dah dah dah. “Now he hit you in the mouth.”
Didn’t he punch out Jimmy Knepper at one time?
Yeah, he hit him too. I said, “No, I’m not signing that, man. I ain’t going to sign that.”
